decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch line is close to the core seasonal offer and arches are perennial sellers, though four-year-old models may be refreshed.
One-tier pyramids are a staple of this workshop's range and are typically kept for many seasons, even if not prominently shown.
The electronic music box line is the firm's strategic flagship and supports accessory sales, so management keeps it despite its distance from the traditional craft.
The Christmas motif platform is a low-prominence accessory and its sibling platform was already dropped, but it still complements the music box line seasonally.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on core craftsmanship and appeals to collectors and tourists, so it likely remains in the range.
